policies.artifacts: Exact three named card discoveries through CARD_DISCOVERY and ordinary AddToHand materialization. All three choices retained; Mummy Zombie only downstream.
policies.generated_legendary: Frozen Champion uses the complete ordinary constructed.cards domain in the actual generation context, collectible Legendary minions of all classes. Never use the past732 or executable coverage as this domain.
policies.wildseeds: Source-defined ordered whole group: Fox, Bear, Stag; complete three Dormant minions with existing waking policies. Exact official summon order remains unverified.
policies.distinct_secrets: Five dynamic matching draw slots exclude every prior original selected generation identity, including burned or draw-cast roots; use physical deck multiplicity for each remaining identity.
policies.draws: Ordinary top draws, original slot/replacement hand arrivals and a whole-group reward. Health payment and spell gifts use existing ModifyStoredCost/MoveCard with original residency, no unrelated reaction draws.
policies.copy: Barnes accepts all original own-deck minion physical current-copy candidates with explicit1/1 entry override, one equal physical random selection, no move of the original and no copied Battlecry.
policies.resurrection: Whitemane captures complete friendly current-turn original death IDs before the first resurrection; duplicate physical deaths retained, original order and ordinary capacity.
policies.hand_capacity: Valdris raises to at least12 before ordinary four draws; permanent player capacity survives silence, source death and hero replacement.

uncertainties: Four old Artifact faces are complete fixed local client records with public membership/effect references, but the live primary query returns no matching face. Eight failed full responses remain cached; no official complete-pool certification.
Ara’lon ordered Fox/Bear/Stag group and partial-board position are explicit local policy pending precise CN evidence.
Whole-group Ghuun health-payment and Magatha spell gifts follow the existing replacement-arrival, residency, overflow and reaction policies; exact CN notification ordering remains deferred.
Distinct Secret identity uses existing generation identity aliases. Physical deck candidate weights and ordinary tutor random order are preserved.
Barnes retained stored enchantments, copy override and extra quantity deliveries follow existing current-copy policy pending precise CN edge calibration.
Patch/hotfix alignment, full original past source, formal eligibility and all other open domains remain incomplete.
